question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Keep count of
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **To remember a total.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Keep count of" means **to maintain a record or be aware of the number or amount of something,** often to ensure accuracy or monitor a quantity (किसी कुल को याद रखना).
 
• To remember a total means to recall or keep in mind the cumulative or final amount of something (किसी कुल को याद रखना).
 
 
• Example: It's important to keep count of how many people have RSVP'd to the event to arrange the right amount of catering.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is- To remember a total.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To remind of a deadline (एक समय सीमा की याद दिलाना) means to prompt or alert someone about an upcoming time by which something must be completed.
 
• To act more politely (अधिक शिष्टता से काम करना) means to behave in a more courteous, respectful, or considerate manner.
 
• To accept an invitation (निमंत्रण स्वीकार करना) means to agree to attend or participate in an event or activity for which one has been invited.

38:Tb66,
The correct answer is Option 4. i.e. **Hypocrisy.**
